name: Reasoning Gym LLM baseline checkpoint-timeout patch
purpose: Continue the SPEC-v1 baseline-first reproduction by fixing the L1 one-shot baseline blocker from Item088. Adds checkpoint/resume, row-key skipping, request timeout, batch chunking, and max-new-row controls to the unified Reasoning Gym baseline matrix runner. Verifies that a slow graph_color one-shot request now produces a checkpointed TIMEOUT row and a final baseline matrix artifact instead of hanging without output.

code_added_used.change: Adds checkpoint/resume for LLM rows, row-key skipping, request timeout, --llm-task-batch-size, --max-new-llm-rows, --checkpoint-path, and --no-resume.

commands.purpose: Validate the patched baseline matrix runner compiles.
Verify one L1-one_shot_direct row is checkpointed and final artifact is written even when the request times out.

headline.single_next_move: Use the patched runner to populate L1-one_shot_direct baselines row-budgeted across Tier-1; increase request_timeout for real reads while preserving TIMEOUT rows.

gate_outcomes.number: Checkpoint artifact contains one graph_color L1-one_shot_direct row.
The row records status=TIMEOUT, error='TimeoutError: timed out', and zero tokens.
Final matrix artifact includes the TIMEOUT row plus no-LLM baselines.
This patch enables LLM baseline accumulation; it does not resume M-register or multi-agent method comparisons.

decision.next_step_routing: Populate L1-one_shot_direct baselines using row-budgeted checkpointed runs, first graph_color then sudoku then zebra_puzzles. Keep method comparisons paused until the baseline table has enough n for the target bins.

rows.reason: Thinking needs anti-truncation and larger timeout budget.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not complete the L1 baseline table and does not compare any method. It only proves timeout/checkpoint behavior for one LLM baseline row.
honesty.timeout_limit: The smoke used request_timeout=30 to force a bounded test; real baseline reads should use a larger timeout while still preserving TIMEOUT rows.
honesty.baseline_first_scope: Method comparisons remain paused until Reasoning Gym baselines are populated.
